ptr.note: The source frame, read only (const): av_frame_ref copies its properties, deep-copies metadata, side data entries (sharing their buffers) and channel layout, adds references to buf[], extended_buf[], hw_frames_ctx, opaque_ref (unchecked 32-bit AVBuffer counts) and private_ref, memdup's nb_channels entries of a separate extended_data; when buf[0] is NULL it copies the data through av_frame_get_buffer + av_frame_copy instead, which reads src's planes through its geometry and fails (EINVAL) when they are NULL. That av_frame_get_buffer(dst, 0) overflows int for audio of INT_MAX - 31 samples (av_samples_get_buffer_size's FFALIGN rounding): Rust's try_clone refuses such a non-refcounted source.

A new av_frame_alloc'd frame referencing the same buffers (no plane writable while both live), freed with av_frame_free; NULL on failure (allocation, a failed data copy for a non-refcounted source, e.g. any frame without planes). For a non-refcounted source the copy's buffers come from av_frame_get_buffer (av_buffer_alloc): bytes outside the copied lines (padding, alignment gaps) are UNINITIALISED. Rust: FrameRef::try_clone, which first refuses when a buffer's count nears u32::MAX/2, and for a non-refcounted source swaps the copy's buffers for zeroed ones holding the same copy (av_frame_get_buffer + memset + av_frame_copy).
